title: Player Location Swapper
description: A simple lightweight Paper plugin that allows players to swap positions with each other using the /swap command.
body:
# Swap

A lightweight and simple Paper plugin that allows players to swap positions with each other instantly!

⚠️ **BETA VERSION** - This plugin is currently in beta and has not been fully tested. Please report any bugs or issues!

## Features

✨ **Simple Command** - Just type `/swap <player>` to instantly swap positions
🔒 **Permission System** - Operators only by default, configurable for specific players
📝 **Tab Completion** - Easy player name completion
💬 **Feedback Messages** - Colored chat messages for success and errors
🛡️ **Error Handling** - Prevents swapping with yourself, offline players, etc.

## Usage

**Command:** `/swap <player>`

**Permission:** `swap.use` (operators by default)

Example:
- `/swap Steve` - Swaps your position with Steve

To grant permission to non-ops:
- `/luckperms user <player> permission set swap.use true`
- Or use your preferred permission plugin

## Feedback & Support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join our **Discord server** and let us know!

Your feedback helps improve this plugin! 🚀
